title: 고등교육기관의 자체평가에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Self-Evaluation Committee, etc.)
(1) The head of a school shall establish a self-evaluation committee and shall assign an organization and personnel dedicated to self-evaluation for the planning, operation, coordination, management, etc. of self-evaluation.
(2) Matters necessary for the composition and operation of the self-evaluation committee shall be determined by the head of the school.
